Intelligent Auditing Platform

AuditIQ: AI-Powered Auditing for the Modern Enterprise.

Streamline your audit processes, detect anomalies, and ensure compliance with our intelligent platform.

Start Exploring How it Works
Automated
Data Ingestion Engine
Instant
Anomaly Detection
Complete
Audit Coverage

How AuditIQ Works

A unified workflow to ingest, analyze, and report on your enterprise data with unprecedented speed.

01

Data Ingestion

Eliminate manual uploads. Seamlessly pull structured and unstructured data from various ERPs, databases, and external sources into a single, secure environment.

02

AI-Powered Anomaly Detection

Our intelligent algorithms continuously monitor transactions, instantly highlighting flagged records, financial outliers, and policy violations on a centralized dashboard.

Platform Navigation Guide

How to navigate and utilize the core modules of AuditIQ.

📊

Dashboard

The operational hub. Contains high-level KPI alerts, risk matrix bubble charts, and financial trends. Click on any condensed widget here to jump into its full detailed page.

🗄️

Data & Policy

Manage your data sources. Ingest raw Excel, CSV, or PDF files. Define dynamic company policies (like spending limits) using markdown, which the AI engine will enforce globally.

🔍

Audit Workspace

The core review center. Conduct deep-dives into flagged anomalies. Utilize the AI-powered 3-Way Match checker to validate complex procurement lifecycles.

🏢

Vendor Intelligence

Examine third-party risk. View interactive collusion network graphs showing shared IP addresses, bank accounts, or directors between seemingly unrelated vendors.

🗂️

Data Explorer

A unified grid view of all master transactions across the enterprise. Filter, sort, and search across millions of rows with sub-second latency.

📄

Reports

Generate downloadable, board-ready compliance reports. Maintain immutable audit trails of who approved what, and when.

Designed for Financial Leaders

AuditIQ empowers modern audit and finance teams to shift from manual checking to strategic advising.

Internal Auditors

Expand audit coverage to 100% of transactions. Focus your expertise on investigating high-risk anomalies rather than routine sampling.

CFOs & Controllers

Gain real-time visibility into financial integrity. Accelerate the financial close process while ensuring absolute accuracy and zero leakage.

Compliance Officers

Automate policy enforcement across all vendor and internal data. Easily export logs to prove compliance with strict industry regulations.

Ready to Transform Your Auditing Process?

Get a personalized demo and see exactly how AuditIQ can streamline operations for your business.

Request a Demo
